description: Event analytics with Keen - record single events and batches, inspect the collections and property types Keen inferred, run count, sum, average and the rest of its analyses, and manage saved queries and cached datasets.

api.description: One collection’s property names and their inferred types

fields.description: The event collection, such as `purchases`.
Property name to inferred type: `num`, `string`, `bool` and so on.

api.description: Every event collection on the project, with its properties and types

output.type: { name: string, properties?: Record<string, string> | null, url?: string | null }[]

api.description: Delete a cached dataset and its computed rows; it cannot be restored

fields.description: The cached dataset name.
The resource is gone.

api.description: One cached dataset’s definition, including how far behind its computation is

fields.description: The cached dataset name.

api.description: Cached dataset definitions, paged by `after_name`; `next_after_name` carries the cursor

fields.description: Datasets per page. Defaults to 10, and Keen allows at most 100.
The dataset name the next page starts after. Keen’s `next_page_url` names it.

fields.type: { project_id?: string | null, organization_id?: string | null, dataset_name: string, display_name?: string | null, query?: Record<string, any> | null, index_by?: string | string[] | null, last_scheduled_date?: string | null, latest_subtimeframe_available?: string | null, milliseconds_behind?: number | null, status?: string | null }[]

fields.description: The next page while more remain; absent on the last page.
The `after_name` for the next page, read out of `next_page_url`; null on the last page.

api.description: A cached dataset’s computed rows, selected by the values of its `index_by` properties

fields.description: The cached dataset name.
The index value that selects the rows: a string for a single string index property, or an object of property name to value when there are several or the value is not a string.
A relative timeframe in the dataset’s own unit, or an absolute window that lines up with its intervals.

fields.type: number | string | boolean | null | (number | string | boolean | null | Record<string, any>)[] | Record<string, any>

api.description: Record one event in a collection; Keen answers `created` and takes up to 10 seconds to make it queryable

fields.description: The event collection, such as `purchases`.
The event body. Its keys become properties. `keen.timestamp` overrides when Keen records it.

api.description: Record events across one or more collections in one request, with a result per event. Keen recommends batches of 5,000 or less

fields.description: Collection name to events. Keen recommends batches of 5,000 or less.

api.description: The type Keen inferred for one property, such as `num` or `string`

fields.description: The event collection, such as `purchases`.
The property name, which may contain dots, such as `item.price`.

api.description: Run up to 10 analyses over one collection in one request, each under its own label

fields.description: The event collection, such as `purchases`.
